export type TranslationKey = keyof typeof TRANSLATIONS.zh;
export const DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS = TRANSLATIONS.zh;

// --- Appearance Themes ---
export type AccentTheme = 'zinc' | 'amber' | 'emerald' | 'sky' | 'violet' | 'rose';

export const accentThemes: Record<AccentTheme, {
  name: string;
  nameZh: string;
  primary: string;
  dataAttr: string;
}> = {
  zinc:    { name: 'Obsidian', nameZh: '黑曜石', primary: '#18181b', dataAttr: 'zinc'    },
  amber:   { name: 'Lantern',  nameZh: '灯笼橙', primary: '#d97706', dataAttr: 'amber'   },
  emerald: { name: 'Forest',   nameZh: '森林绿', primary: '#059669', dataAttr: 'emerald' },
  sky:     { name: 'Diamond',  nameZh: '钻石蓝', primary: '#0284c7', dataAttr: 'sky'     },
  violet:  { name: 'Chorus',   nameZh: '紫颂花', primary: '#7c3aed', dataAttr: 'violet'  },
  rose:    { name: 'Nether',   nameZh: '地狱红', primary: '#e11d48', dataAttr: 'rose'    },
};

/** 
 * applyAccent - Injects theme attribute into the document root
 */
export function applyAccent(accent: AccentTheme) {
  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-accent', accent);
  }
}

// --- Store Implementation ---
interface UIState {
  locale: Locale;
  accent: AccentTheme;
  setLocale: (locale: Locale) => void;
  setAccent: (accent: AccentTheme) => void;
}

export const useUIStore = create<UIState>()(
  persist(
    (set) => ({
      locale: 'zh',
      accent: 'zinc',
      setLocale: (locale) => set({ locale }),
      setAccent: (accent) => {
        set({ accent });
        applyAccent(accent);
      },
    }),
    { name: 'qianfu-ui-prefs' }
  )
);

/**
 * useT - Simple translation hook
 */
export function useT() {
  const currentLocale = useUIStore((s) => s.locale);
  
  return useCallback(
    (key: TranslationKey): string => {
      // @ts-ignore - dynamic key access
      return TRANSLATIONS[currentLocale][key] || key;
    },
    [currentLocale]
  );
}

/**
 * staticT - Translation helper for non-React contexts
 */
export function staticT(key: TranslationKey): string {
  const state = useUIStore.getState();
  const locale = state.locale || 'zh';
  // @ts-ignore
  return TRANSLATIONS[locale][key] || key;
}
